function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Stations in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy Highlights | Contact | |---------|---------|-----------------------|---------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 | • Amtrak allows small pets (≤ 20 lb) in carriers on most trains.
• Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• No pets on the platform or in the waiting area.
• The station itself is pet‑friendly: there are covered outdoor areas and a small “pet relief” zone near the entrance. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Amtrak – Miami](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/miami) | | **Miami Central Station (Florida Railway Museum)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 (shared with Amtrak) | • The museum’s visitor center is pet‑friendly; pets are allowed in the lobby but not in exhibits.
• The adjacent Amtrak platform follows the same pet rules as above. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Florida Railway Museum](https://www.floridamuseum.org) | | **Miami Beach Station (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 (same building as Central) | • Same pet policy as the Intermodal Center.
• The station is close to the beach, so you can walk your pet outside the station before or after your train. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Amtrak – Miami](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/miami) | | **Miami Airport Rail Link (planned)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 (future extension) | • When completed, it will connect the Intermodal Center to Miami International Airport.
• Amtrak’s pet policy will apply. | N/A (under construction) | ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Pets from Miami 1. **Check Amtrak’s Pet Policy** – Before booking, confirm the pet size limit, carrier requirements, and any fees. 2. **Arrive Early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet. 3. **Use the Covered Outdoor Areas** – The Intermodal Center has a shaded patio where pets can stretch. 4. **Stay Hydrated** – Bring a collapsible water bowl and a small bag of treats. 5. **Plan a Break** – If you’re on a long trip, schedule a stop at a pet‑friendly café or park along the route. If you need more detailed information (e.g., exact carrier dimensions, pet fees, or special accommodations), feel free to let me know!
